claims.quote: After nearly 12 years in business … will shut down; announced April 9, 2026; changing market conditions. Interest from multiple prospective buyers; operations expected to continue into early May [2026].
claims.source: CBC News + CTV + Northern Ontario Business + The Manitoulin Expositor (independent outlets)
claims.note: REGISTRY CARRIES THIS AS ACTIVE. Own website still serves, so site-health cannot catch it. Multiple independent news outlets = as strong as closure evidence gets. Buyer interest means it could reopen under new ownership — watch, don't delete.

claims.quote: Killarney Cream Ale won gold at the 2022 Ontario Brewing Awards; Cup and Saucer English Ale silver (Canada Beer Awards); flagship Swing Bridge Blonde Ale 'approachable gateway to craft beer'
claims.note: Real medals, now moot for routing. THE CASE for liveness gating awards: without the closure check, the awards pass would rank a dead brewery.

claims.quote: outdoor bar made from an old grain bin; pet-friendly patio; on-site food truck (smoked meats, burgers, poutine)

snowball: Split Rail Brewing Co. (Gore Bay) — the OTHER Manitoulin Island brewery, appears alive; roster check
pilot_lesson: Picked as the remote-north COVERAGE floor; turned out to be a LIVENESS catch instead. The wide harvest doubles as the closure detector no other layer provides: OSM lags, the domain still serves, AGCO licence may not lapse for months.
